query: Please implement a television video playback website for playing TV videos and managing charging functions. The website should have functionalities for video playback, TV set-top box charging, and mobile phone recharge. Users should be able to log in, browse and play TV videos, manage their own charging information, and perform mobile phone recharge operations. Configure your theme with thistle as background and rebecca purple as component color.
